_comment: AGENT DEBUG preset: focused on subagent behavior. The agents channel already splits per agent type and collects each agent's own entries by default, so every .agents-<type>_*.log carries that agent's full story -- dispatch prompt, start and stop brackets, its own tool calls, its narration and reasoning, and its report. The entries below add what debugging wants on top: agent ids in the labels so two runs of one type read apart, and Claude Code's typeless side-queries kept out of the conversation view (they still appear in sesslog and in their own file). To watch only specific agents, use the list forms: "collect": {"agent_context": ["oracle", "senior-engineer"]} with a matching "subtype_split".
